Write the raw text that a person would get by pressing Select All then Copy on a FastJobs-style mobile-friendly job page in Singapore, for a fictional employer and a made-up job. Output the pasted text ONLY: no commentary, no markdown, no code fences. Include realistic page furniture (menu text, buttons, banners, footer links). Target 250 to 400 words. Requirements for this paste:
- a short phone-style copy with no menu text, starting with one line like an emoji, the job title and the pay
- the employer is named in a line near the top
- duties given in 2 or 3 short lines
- the text says 'Apply anytime, no deadline'
Today is 2026-11-10; any dates you write must be in November or December 2026.
